title: Firmware Updates & Error Codes

expressions.expr: You should update the firmware to the latest version
expressions.meaning: Você deve atualizar o firmware para a versão mais recente
expressions.example: You should update the firmware to the latest version — that usually fixes this.

expressions.expr: Let me run a diagnostic test first
expressions.meaning: Deixa eu rodar um teste de diagnóstico primeiro
expressions.example: I am not sure yet. Let me run a diagnostic test first.

expressions.expr: Do not remove the USB drive during the update
expressions.meaning: Não remova o pen drive durante a atualização
expressions.example: Wait five minutes. Do not remove the USB drive during the update.

expressions.expr: We saved a backup of your field settings
expressions.meaning: Salvamos um backup das suas configurações de talhão
expressions.example: Before the reset, we saved a backup of your field settings.

sentences: The display shows an error code on startup.
Let me run a diagnostic test first.
You should update the firmware to the latest version.
Insert the USB drive into the monitor.
Do not turn off the screen during the update.
We saved a backup of your settings.
A firmware update fixed the connection issue.
Now reboot the system and check the signal.

grammar.title: Dando recomendação técnica: You should / You shouldn't
rules: Use should + verbo base para recomendar o procedimento técnico correto: "You should update the firmware."
Use shouldn't + verbo base para avisar o que não é recomendável: "You shouldn't unplug the USB drive now."
Para pedir conselho ao suporte do fabricante: "Should I run a factory reset?"
Depois de should, o verbo vai sempre na forma pura (sem "to" e sem "-s").
